argv:
import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import harness_registry as H
import fleet_state as F
import execution_runner as R
from execute_provider import provider_contract
reg = H.load_registry()
assert reg["seat_specs"]["agy.premium"] == ["agy", "argon"] and reg["seat_specs"]["agy.economy"] == ["agy", "flash"], "seat specs"
assert reg["doors"]["agy-argon"] == {"provider": "agy", "billing_class": "included", "pool": "agy-argon", "no_zdr": False, "priority": 2}, "argon door"
assert reg["doors"]["agy"]["pool"] == "google", "flash door"
assert reg["pools"]["agy-argon"]["windows"] == ["weekly"], "weekly-only pool"
assert {d["pool"] for d in reg["doors"].values()} == set(reg["pools"]), "door pools"
broken = copy.deepcopy(reg); del broken["pools"]
try:
    H.validate_registry(broken)
except H.RegistryError as exc:
    assert str(exc) == "registry missing required field: pools", str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("registry without pools accepted")
doors = reg["doors"]
assert R.registry_door_pool_and_billing(doors, "agy", "gemini-4-argon-high") == ("agy-argon", "agy-argon", "included"), "argon row"
assert R.registry_door_pool_and_billing(doors, "agy", "gemini-3.8-flash-medium") == ("agy", "google", "included"), "flash row"
older = {k: v for k, v in doors.items() if k != "agy-argon"}
assert R.registry_door_pool_and_billing(older, "agy", "gemini-4-argon-high") == ("agy", "google", "included"), "older base registry"
fleet = json.load(open("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/fleet.json"))
fleet["seats"]["agy.premium"] = {"provider": "agy", "model": "gemini-4-argon-high", "family": "argon", "effort": "high", "speed": "unknown",
                                 "health": "healthy", "source": "observed", "capabilities": F.CAPABILITIES["agy"]}
F.validate_fleet(fleet)
fleet["seats"]["agy.premium"]["family"] = "pro"
try:
    F.validate_fleet(fleet)
except F.PolicyError as exc:
    assert str(exc) == "fleet seat provider/family mismatch", str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("family pro accepted")
argv, _ = provider_contract({"provider": "agy", "model": "gemini-4-argon-high", "effort": "high", "speed": "unknown", "repo": "/r", "prompt": "P",
                             "write_scope": [], "role": "worker", "provider_contract_version": 8})
assert argv == ["agy", "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--print-timeout", "30m", "--model", "gemini-4-argon-high", "--output-format", "stream-json", "-p", "P"], argv
print("ok")
